
calls.topic: Why did my sourdough loaf not rise?
calls.label: Laying out the causes
calls.final:
I've laid out five likely causes for the flat loaf, plus two quick checks that would tell them apart: how active your starter is, and how the dough looked at the end of the bulk rise.

```map
{"ops":[
{"op":"add","id":"root","parent":null,"kind":"question","title":"Why didn't my sourdough rise?","summary":"Find the likeliest cause of a flat or dense loaf.","status":"open"},
{"op":"frame","q":"root","shape":"causes"},
{"op":"add","id":"starter","parent":"root","kind":"option","title":"Weak or immature starter","summary":"Starter too young or used past its peak, so too little yeast activity.","status":"proposed"},
{"op":"add","id":"under","parent":"root","kind":"option","title":"Underproofed dough","summary":"Bulk or final proof too short, often because the kitchen was cool.","status":"proposed"},
{"op":"add","id":"over","parent":"root","kind":"option","title":"Overproofed dough","summary":"Proofed too long, so the gluten gave out and the dough collapsed.","status":"proposed"},
{"op":"add","id":"gluten","parent":"root","kind":"option","title":"Weak gluten structure","summary":"Too little folding, low-protein flour, or too much water to hold gas.","status":"proposed"},
{"op":"add","id":"shaping","parent":"root","kind":"option","title":"Shaping or baking issue","summary":"Loose shaping, no steam, or an oven that wasn't hot enough flattened it.","status":"proposed"},
{"op":"add","id":"chk-float","parent":"root","kind":"fact","title":"Starter activity check","summary":"To check: does the starter double within 4–8h after feeding? This tests the starter cause.","status":"info"},
{"op":"add","id":"chk-bulk","parent":"root","kind":"fact","title":"End-of-bulk dough check","summary":"To check: was the dough puffy, domed, and about 50–75% bigger? This separates under- from overproofing.","status":"info"},
{"op":"takeaway","node":"chk-float","text":"Run first: a weak starter is the most common cause of a flat loaf."},
{"op":"stand","q":"root","lead":null,"line":"The starter's rise after feeding and how the dough looked at the end of bulk will narrow it down.","sure":null}
]}
```
